properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1 implemented in the project's crypto layer (CryptoUtil.sha1 → cryptoRuntime.sha1, CryptoUtil.scala:59/63) and wired as the Bitcoin Script OP_SHA1 opcode (CryptoInterpreter.scala:67). Consensus-mandated by the Bitcoin protocol — observable here, replaceable only by the Bitcoin ecosystem via a protocol fork, not by this project. The crypto-test site exercises the helper.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The codebase's core crypto asset: ECDSA and BIP340 Schnorr signatures on Bitcoin's secp256k1 curve, executed by the bundled libsecp256k1 JNI bindings (NativeSecp256k1.java: secp256k1_ecdsa_sign/verify, secp256k1_schnorrsig_sign/verify, secp256k1_ecdsa_adaptor_* for DLC adaptor signatures, secp256k1_ecdh for BIP47 payment codes, pubkey create/combine/tweak, privkey tweaks, secp256k1_context_randomize), loaded via Secp256k1Context.java (NativeLoader.loadLibrary("secp256k1")). properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256-CFB with NoPadding in AesCrypt — the wallet at-rest encryption path (AesEncryptedData) encrypting wallet secrets under PBKDF2-derived keys (AesCrypt.scala:110). Unauthenticated, malleable mode; no MAC applied. Changeable here: yes — migrate the wallet encryption to AES-GCM.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Positive posture control on the wallet server's authentication path: the gRPC server's RPC credential check uses a constant-time comparison, so it does not leak by timing. Kept as inventory evidence of that control.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA3-256 (Keccak) provided by the crypto runtime (BouncyCastle-backed), used to compute Tor v3 onion-address checksums per the Tor rendezvous-spec-v3 ("CHECKSUM = SHA3-256(".onion checksum" || PUBKEY || VERSION)"), with digest types Sha3_256Digest/BE defined in HashDigest.scala. Post-quantum-acceptable hash; A- rating appropriate.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two live consumers with resolved parameters: (1) BIP39 mnemonic-to-seed (BIP39Seed.scala:55): PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, 2048 iterations, 512-bit output — the iteration count is fixed by the BIP39 standard (BIP39Seed.scala:39), so observable here but replaceable only by the BIP39 ecosystem. (2) Wallet password to AES-256 key (AesCrypt.scala:110): AesPassword.ITERATIONS = 65536, KEY_SIZE = 256 (AesCrypt.scala:124/125) — changeable here, and 65536 is below OWASP's 210k recommendation for PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA5

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA256 implementing Tor control-port SAFECOOKIE authentication (challenge/response with ServerKey/ClientKey derived from the Tor auth cookie) in TorProtocolHandler. HMAC-SHA256 is post-quantum-acceptable; A- rating appropriate.
